opennyai_summary.facts:
"The petitioner seeks grant of anticipatory bail in case bearing FIR No.918 dated 23.11.2022 registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, (Section 201 IPC added later on) at Police Station Panipat City, District Panipat.
A status report dated 13.07.2024 by way of an affidavit of Sandeep Kumar, HPS, Deputy Superintendent of Police, HQ, Panipat has been filed on behalf of the State by the learned counsel for the State.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
The learned counsel for the petitioner contends that de hors the nature of the allegations against the petitioner,
to prove his bona fide the petitioner is ready and willing to deposit Rs.5 lakhs with the Trial Court.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Notice of motion for 15.07.2024.
In the meantime, subject to a deposit of Rs.5 lakhs with the Trial Court, the petitioner is directed to appear before the SHO/Investigating Officer to join investigation and in the event of his arrest, he shall be released on bail on his furnishing bail bonds to the satisfaction of SHO/Investigating Agency subject to the following conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C:-
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:087367 CRM-M-23994-2024 i) that the petitioner shall make himself available for interrogation before the Investigating Officer as and when required;
ii) that the petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
iii) that the petitioner shall not leave the country, without prior permission of the Court and shall surrender his passport, if any.
The same is taken on record.
As the petitioner has refused to comply with the aforementioned order, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition.
The present petition is ordered to be dismissed as withdrawn.
